items.claim: Q1 FY2027 (quarter ended 30 September 2026): Reported 28 October 2026: revenue $92.3 billion (+19%); operating income $45.9 billion (+21%); GAAP net income $36.6 billion (+32%); GAAP diluted EPS $4.92, non-GAAP EPS $4.89 (+18%, excluding a $207 million net gain from the OpenAI investment). Microsoft Cloud revenue $63.9 billion (+30%), Azure +48%, commercial RPO +73% to $677 billion. Agents and Infra $76.8 billion (+25%); Devices and Consumer $15.5 billion (-3%), with Windows OEM and Devices -22%. Cash additions to property and equipment $39.4 billion vs $19.4 billion a year earlier. $10.2 billion returned to shareholders. Non-GAAP EPS of $4.89 beat a $4.72 consensus and revenue of $92.28 billion beat a $90.62 billion estimate (MarketBeat); 24/7 Wall St calls it the sixth consecutive beat and notes commercial bookings fell 12%.

Q1 FY2027 (quarter ended 30 September 2026): The Q1 FY2027 10-Q shows revenue growth of 19%, capex roughly doubling year on year to $39.4 billion in the quarter, and a new two-segment structure (Agents and Infra; Devices and Consumer) that makes segment figures not directly comparable with the FY2026 annual report.

Norway Datatilsynet fined Microsoft subsidiary Xandr NOK 92 million (about USD 9.6 million) for sharing Grindr users' sensitive data without valid consent in 2018-2020 (pre-acquisition conduct); appeal status unknown
Delaware Court of Chancery gave final approval to a USD 250 million settlement (Microsoft funding 40%) of the Activision Blizzard stockholder class action over the merger price, without admission
UK CMA published a proposed decision to designate Microsoft with strategic market status in business software; Microsoft disputes it; no infringement finding or fine
US FTC escalated its antitrust investigation into whether Microsoft illegally monopolizes parts of enterprise computing via cloud, licensing and AI; no complaint or charge found
Australian ACCC sued Microsoft in the Federal Court alleging it misled about 2.7 million Microsoft 365 Personal and Family subscribers over Copilot price rises without disclosing the Classic plan
European Commission opened a DMA market investigation into whether Azure should be designated a gatekeeper cloud service; no final designation retrieved
European Commission closed the Teams tying case by accepting legally binding commitments; no fine and no formal infringement finding
US FTC dropped its challenge to the Activision Blizzard acquisition after losing its preliminary-injunction appeal at the Ninth Circuit
Irish Data Protection Commission fined LinkedIn Ireland EUR 310 million with a reprimand and compliance order over processing of member data for behavioural analysis and targeted ads; under appeal
US IRS issued Notices of Proposed Adjustment seeking USD 28.9 billion in additional tax plus penalties and interest for 2004-2013 (transfer pricing); Microsoft contests, no assessment finalized
US FTC and DOJ: Microsoft agreed to a USD 20 million civil penalty and injunctive terms over Xbox Live COPPA violations
US Treasury OFAC and Commerce BIS imposed a combined USD 3.3 million in civil penalties for sanctions and export-control violations (2012-2019), voluntarily self-disclosed

US DOJ and SEC: Microsoft paid USD 25.3 million to resolve FCPA books-and-records and internal-controls violations tied to improper payments at foreign subsidiaries; Microsoft Hungary entered a non-prosecution agreement
European Commission fined Microsoft EUR 561 million for failing to show the browser-choice screen to Windows 7 SP1 users, breaching binding commitments
